bot.description: Whether the account says it is a bot, as dev.knotless.profile's `bot`. Left out, it stays as it is.

links.description: The links to show, in order, in place of those there were; none shows the Bluesky profile's.

description.description: Free text about the account: its bio.

displayName.description: The name shown over the account's handle.

removeAvatar.description: Takes the picture out, so the Bluesky profile's shows again. dev.knotless.uploadAvatar sets one.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: A field is too long, or a link is no http or https address.

errors.name: AuthenticationRequired
errors.description: No account is logged in to the pages, or its session has ended.

main.description: Changes the dev.knotless.profile record of the account logged in to this appview's web pages, as `knotless account profile` does: a field left out stays as it is, and one given empty is taken out, so the Bluesky profile's shows again. A profile left with nothing in it is deleted. Requires the session cookie the pages' login sets: the appview writes with the session it keeps for that account. Clients holding their own session write the record themselves.

description: Changes how the account logged in to this appview's pages shows on knotless.
